title: Integra Magbead DNA and RNA Extraction for Isolated Colonies
author: Sophana Chea

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary stock solutions and reconstituted enzymes.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 concentrate.
Add 30 mL isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 concentrate.
Reconstitute lyophilized Proteinase K to 20 mg/mL using Proteinase K Storage Buffer; vortex and use immediately or store at -20 °C.
Reconstitute lyophilized DNase I with 2.25 mL DNase/RNase-Free water in a conical tube.
Prepare DNase I Reaction Mix (scale proportionally): combine 45 µL reconstituted DNase I and 5 µL DNA Digestion Buffer in a nuclease-free tube, mix by gentle inversion, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Pre-make Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the following plates for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Lysis Buffer plate: 520 µL DNA/RNA Lysis buffer in a 1ml deep well plate.
Beads plate: 35 µL ZymoBIOMIC MagBinding Beads in a 96 V-well PCR plate (prepare <1h before starting).
DNA/RNA Wash 1 plates: 520 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 in 1ml deep well plates (prepare 2 plates).
DNA/RNA Wash 2 plates: 520 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 in 1ml deep well plates (prepare 2 plates).
100% Ethanol plates: 1100 µL of 100% Ethanol in 2ml deep well plates (prepare 3 plates).
Prep Buffer plate: 520 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer in a 1ml deep well plate.
Water plates: 60 µL Nuclease-free water in 96 V-well PCR plates (prepare 2 plates).
Centrifuge all plates at 12,000 rpm for 00:01:00, except for the bead plate, which should only receive a quick pulse spin.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare isolated colony samples and initiate lysis using the Integra workstation.

substeps.instruction: Create a plate map and add 50 µL of isolated colony samples to plate 1 (column 12 is for water control).
Top up 1x DNA/RNA Shield to 750 µL.
Manually add 120 µL of Proteinase K into the 0.2ml 8-strip well.
Use a multichannel pipet to add 10 µL of Proteinase K to each sample in plate 1 and mix.
Load Integra tip set 1. Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 15 cycles, speed 4. Pipet 250 µL of samples up and down for 00:01:00, then incubate at room temperature for 00:30:00 (keep tips).
Program: Pipet 250µL. Add 500 µL total Lysis Buffer to plate 1.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix samples and buffer for 00:02:00 (keep tips).

steps.title: DNA Binding and RNA Separation
steps.instruction: Bind DNA to magnetic beads and separate the RNA supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 35 µL MagBinding Beads into a 96 V-well PCR plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 20µL, 10 cycles, 2 times, speed 4 to resuspend beads.
Program: Pipet 30µL. Add 30 µL MagBinding Beads to plate 1.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 3. Mix sample and beads for 00:20:00.
Place plate on magnetic stand for 00:05:00 until beads pellet; transfer the cleared supernatant (RNA) into a new 96 V-well plate.

steps.title: DNA Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and elute it into a new plate.

substeps.instruction: Change Integra tips. Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 into sample plate and mix.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Wash 1 with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into 2ml deep well waste plate.
Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 into sample plate and mix.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Wash 2 with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Change Integra tips. Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL 100% Ethanol into sample plate and mix.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Ethanol with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Repeat the 100% Ethanol wash (dispense 500 µL, mix, pellet, and discard).
Dry beads on the magnetic stand for 00:10:00.
Change Integra tips. Program: Pipet 30µL, speed 5. Dispense 30 µL nuclease-free water into the sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 20µL, 30 cycles, speed 7. Mix water with beads (keep tips).
Program: Manual Pipet 30µL, speed 3. Pellet beads on magnetic stand for 00:05:00, then aspirate and dispense eluted DNA to a new 96 V-well plate.
Store DNA samples immediately at -80 °C.

steps.title: RNA Recovery and Purification
steps.instruction: Recover RNA from the previously saved supernatant and purify it.

substeps.instruction: Change Integra tips. Program: Pipet 230µL, 3 times, speed 7. Dispense 690 µL 100% Ethanol to the RNA supernatant.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 7. Mix Ethanol with supernatant (keep tips).
Aliquot 35 µL MagBinding Beads into a 96 V-well PCR plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 20µL, 10 cycles, 2 times, speed 4 to resuspend beads.
Program: Pipet 30µL. Add 30 µL MagBinding beads to the sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 10 cycles, speed 3. Mix sample and beads for 00:10:00.
Place on magnetic stand for 00:05:00 until beads pellet, then discard the cleared supernatant.
Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 into sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Wash 1 with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 into sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Wash 2 with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL 100% Ethanol into the sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Ethanol with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Repeat the 100% Ethanol wash (dispense 500 µL, mix, pellet, and discard).
Use a multichannel pipet to transfer 50 µL of DNase I Reaction Mix and mix gently for 00:10:00.
Program: Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 7. Dispense 500 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer into sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 250µL, 30 cycles, speed 10. Mix Prep Buffer with beads (keep tips).
Place on magnetic stand for 00:02:00 until a bead ring forms.
Program: Manual Pipet 250µL, 2 times, speed 3. Aspirate and discard supernatant into waste plate.
Repeat the DNA/RNA Prep Buffer wash (dispense 500 µL, mix, pellet, and discard).
Program: Pipet 30µL, speed 5. Dispense 30 µL nuclease-free water into the sample plate.
Program: Pipet/Mix 20µL, 30 cycles, speed 7. Mix water with beads (keep tips).
Program: Manual Pipet 30µL, speed 3. Pellet beads on magnetic stand for 00:05:00, then aspirate and dispense eluted RNA to a new 96 V-well plate.
Store RNA samples immediately at -80 °C.
